Which of the following statements regarding conditioning regimens in allotransplant is NOT true?

options.A: Historically, pre-HSCT conditioning aimed to eradicate the hematological malignancy, provide sufficient immune suppression (IS) to ensure engraftment, and provide stem cell niches in the host bone marrow for the incoming stem cells.
options.B: A conditioning regimen consists of myelodepletion and lymphodepletion.
options.C: Melphalan or busulfan are more lymphodepletion in nature, whereas fludarabine or cyclophosphamide are more myelodepletion.
options.D: Total body irradiation (TBI) provides both myelosuppression and immune suppression.

stem: Which of the following statements regarding conditioning regimens in allotransplant is NOT true?

options.A: The dose intensity of pre-HSCT conditioning regimens in MAC (myeloablative conditioning), RTC (reduced toxicity conditioning), RIC (reduced intensity conditioning), and NMA (non-MA) is decreased in order.
options.B: RTC regimens cause profound cytopenia and should be administered with stem cells, but cytopenia may not be irreversible.
options.C: TBI (total body irradiation) provides a homogenous dose distribution in the whole body, including sanctuaries not easily reached by systemic chemotherapy.
options.D: TBI provides a different mechanism of tumor cell killing against chemotherapy-resistant cell clones.

stem: Which of the following statements regarding GVHD prophylaxis is NOT true?

options.A: Standard GVHD prophylaxis relies on calcineurin inhibitor and short-term MTX (methotrexate) after MAC and of CSA (cyclosporin A) and/or MMF (mycophenolate mofetil) after RIC.
options.B: ATG significantly reduces the rate and severity of acute GVHD in most randomized clinical trials.
options.C: The target trough plasma level of CSA in allotransplant with MUD (matched unrelated donor) is 380 ng/ml.
options.D: The starting dosage of CSA in allotransplant with MUD is 3 mg/kg/day intravenously.
